requirement_vague: Creating a todo without a title returns a validation error

omissions.description: When creating a todo with a missing or empty title, the code does not return a 400 Bad Request with a message containing 'The Title field is required.' FastAPI/Pydantic returns a 422 Unprocessable Entity for missing required fields, and an empty string title passes validation entirely. There is no custom validation logic to enforce this requirement.
omissions.reasoning: The TodoCreate model defines 'title: str' which causes Pydantic to return a 422 status code (not 400) when title is missing, and accepts empty strings without error. The requirement specifies a 400 status code and a specific error message 'The Title field is required.' which is never produced by the code.
